question: Alternatives to the age cap for bounding recovery and trail length.
number: No cap (kappa 20 stands in): +0.00517 bit and an unbounded recovery that cannot be charged. Cap by halting instead of cutting: same arithmetic as the kappa sweep. Fixed-length trails (no DP): detect only merges at equal depth, so they miss collisions (argued, not run). Brent/Floyd instead of DP: see GENERIC.DPFRAC Q4 (+0.63 / +1.19 bit).
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|GENERIC.CHAINLEN|GENERIC|Q4. Fixed-length trails argument: end(A)=f^(l-i)(m), end(B)=f^(l-j)(m) differ when i != j; not simulated.
